summary: Direct3D device configuration routine: releases prior renderer resources, (re)initializes device state when missing, creates three audio emitters, negotiates supported display/backbuffer/depth-stencil formats and multisample modes through an adapter object vtable, selects a final device format set, configures windowed/fullscreen present parameters, sets the render target, configures an audio emitter device, and extracts hardware capability flags. Returns -1 on any setup failure; otherwise returns the negated result of a final resource verification call. Called by sub_55BD20.

Call RendererResourceCleanup(a3) to release prior renderer resources before reconfiguration.
If this+0x1100 (device/state pointer) is null, call sub_53D970(this, a7) to rebuild the device state and set v50=1.
Call FieldGetterAt0x118(a2) to read a configuration field from the caller-supplied a2 object.
Allocate 60 bytes (OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper) and create an AudioEmitter for each of three emitter slots, storing the results at this+0x1524, this+0x1528 and this+0x152C (0 when allocation fails).

Configure the current format descriptor: sub_55C650(this+0x110C, a6, 0), then sub_55C450(*(this+0x110C), &v51, 0) which returns a format code in v51.

Negotiate display modes through the adapter object vtable at *(*(this+0x10FC)+0x0)+40, probing combinations of format/depth-stencil/backbuffer arguments against the adapter info structure (offsets 0x14, 0x28, 0x2C, 0x3C) and device caps structure (offsets 0x10, 0x1C, 0x38, 0x40, 0x7C, 0xC8) to test which modes are supported.

Pick supporting format codes: this+0x13EC from 21/22/23 by preference, this+0x13F0=22 or 0, this+0x13F4=21 or 0, this+0x1400=23, this+0x1404=25/24 based on which mode probes succeeded.
If v51==16, inspect *a2 mode flags (0x1000000 -> 23, 0x4000000 -> 24, 0x2000000 -> 25) to override this+0x110C, then sub_55C450(*(this+0x13E8), 0, this+0x1558).
If v51==24 or v51==32, inspect *a2 mode flags (0x8000000 -> 20, 0x20000000 -> 22, 0x10000000 -> 21) to override this+0x110C, then sub_55C450(*(this+0x13EC), 0, this+0x1558).

When (a7 & 0x100560) is set and (*a2 & 0x802E0) is set, attempt multisample configuration through the adapter vtable +44 slot; per a7 flag bits (0x20->2, 0x100->3, 0x40->4, 0x400->6, 0x100000->16) store the sample count at this+0x1114 and record the matching a7 bit in v49 on success.

If (a7 & 2) (windowed path): set this+0x1120=0; set this+0x1118=1 when a present mode was chosen else clear this+0x1114 and set this+0x1118=2; when (a7 & 0x80) and (*a2 & 0x10) store 1 at this+0x1134 else store 0x80000000; always store a8 at this+0x1130.
Else (fullscreen path): set this+0x1120=1; set this+0x1118=1 when a present mode was chosen else clear this+0x1114 and set this+0x1118=4 (with a2 bit 0x10 set) or 3; store 0 at this+0x1130.
Persist the fixed configuration: this+0x1104=a4, this+0x1108=a5, this+0x111C=a3, this+0x1110=1, this+0x1124=0, this+0x1128=80.

Else (v50 unset): create the device through the existing device object's vtable *(*(this+0x1100)+0x0)+56 with this+0x1104 as the parameter block.

Return -(sub_53EB70(0) != 0): -1 when the final resource verification fails, else 0.
